description: Texas Basemap - Transportation Map Data is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by (deposited on HydroShare). This resource contains statewide networks of roadways, railroads, bridges, and low-water crossings, for Texas only. Roadways detail: The Transportation Planning and Programming (TPP) Division of the Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) maintains a spatial dataset of roadway polylines for planning and asset inventory purposes, as well as for visualization and general mapping. Coverage: Texas, United States. The resource was created 2023-11-02 and last updated 2026-01-29; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
